title: Cinnamon: A Framework for Scale-Out Encrypted AI
problem: Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) imposes orders-of-magnitude performance overhead for ML inference, and prior FHE accelerators use massive monolithic chip designs that do not scale to large models like BERT and provide poor performance-per-dollar.
motivation: Privacy-preserving ML via FHE is commercially important but practically infeasible at scale; a 17-hour FHE inference time for BERT on CPU makes deployment impossible, and monolithic accelerator chips cannot be economically scaled up.
method: Cinnamon is a scale-out FHE acceleration framework that exploits parallelism at all program levels using novel algorithms, a compiler, and a chiplet-based hardware design. The compiler identifies and schedules FHE operation parallelism (polynomial NTT, RNS decomposition, key-switching) across multiple chips, while architectural extensions reduce per-chip resource requirements to enable economical scaling. Novel algorithms reduce communication volume between chiplets, enabling a distributed multi-chip FHE accelerator rather than a single monolithic die.
key_novelty: Scale-out chiplet architecture for FHE acceleration with a co-designed compiler and algorithms that distribute FHE polynomial arithmetic across multiple chips, enabling the first feasible FHE inference for large LLMs like BERT.
contributions: Scale-out FHE framework exploiting multi-level parallelism across chips via novel algorithms and compiler.
Architectural extensions that reduce per-chip resource requirements for FHE enabling multi-chip scaling.
2.3x improvement over prior state-of-the-art single-chip FHE designs on small programs.
36,600x speedup over CPU (BERT inference from 17 hours to 1.67 seconds), first demonstration of large-LLM FHE inference.
5x and 2.68x better performance-per-dollar vs. monolithic and chiplet state-of-the-art.

metrics.speedup: 36,600x over CPU; 2.3x over prior state-of-the-art FHE accelerator
metrics.ppa: 5x perf/$ vs monolithic; 2.68x perf/$ vs chiplet SotA

limitations: End-to-end system evaluation and communication interconnect overhead details across many chips are not discussed in the abstract.
primary_theme: scale-out FHE acceleration for encrypted AI inference
